description: 竹田市_災害出場件数【消防本部】 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 竹田市. 2008年（平成20年）からの火災、救急、救助の出場件数です。 資料の基準日は暦年です。. Coverage: 竹田市. The portal files it under the publisher 竹田市. Its tags are 消防. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, html, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-10-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
